messages:
mira: FYI — following up on the postmortem for last week's SLO regression (high tail p99 on text-generation). I sketched a short RACI + tickets list, want to assign owners and confirm handoffs.
jia: thanks Mira. can you paste the proposed assignments here?
mira: sure — TL;DR: 3 remediation tracks: 1) autoscaler tuning + policy guardrails, 2) batching/cache config to reduce head-of-line latency, 3) rollout safety (canary thresholds + fallback).
mira: Proposed owners: autoscaler = @owen (R), batching/cache = @jia (R), rollout safety = @sam (R). Product accountability = @lena (A). Infra SRE consult = @infra-oncall (C). All-engineering updates to be posted to #eng-runtime (I).
owen: I can take autoscaler tuning. I'll open a ticket and a short runbook entry.
jia: I can own the batching changes. need someone to partner on validation harness — @owen ok to pair on load tests?
owen: yep, happy to run pairing session w/ you next Tue.
sam: On rollout safety, I'll draft canary thresholds and rollback playbook. question — do we make fallback to smaller model family automatic, or manual?
lena: accountability note: prefer automated fallback for customer-facing tier, but let's weigh risk. @sam, include decision matrix and risk/benefit in ticket.
mira: tickets: RDW-3421 (autoscaler policy + docs), RDW-3422 (batching + cache opt), RDW-3423 (rollout safety + rollback). please add sub-tasks for validation and monitoring alerts.
postmortem-bot: Assigned RDW-3421 -> owen, RDW-3422 -> jia, RDW-3423 -> sam (automated message).
owen: RDW-3421 created: https://jira.redwood/r/3421 — ETA draft by Fri 3/15. I'll add measurement checklist.
inja-note: (reaction :thumbsup: from jia)
jia: RDW-3422 created and linked to loadtest repo. ETA Wed 3/13 for initial PR. tagging @infra-oncall for test infra quota.
infra-oncall: noted — reserving test pool on Thu 3/14; will update runbook with steps to request extra capacity.
sam: RDW-3423 created, added decision table and playbook stub. putting a canary step that scales down model size automatically if p99 > 1.5x baseline for 3 minutes. open to feedback.
lena: I'll review RDW-3423 and decide on auto vs manual by Mon 3/11. if auto, we need an exec OK for customer tier — will flag in the ticket.
mira: RACI doc snippet (paste): Responsible = implementers (owen/jia/sam), Accountable = product (lena), Consulted = infra-sre & runtime leads (infra-oncall, tj?), Informed = eng, support, success.
mira: handoffs: after implement and unit test, owner schedules a canary with @infra-oncall, then product sign-off, then global rollout. Owner responsible for writing rollback steps.
owen: sync cadence? propose twice-weekly 30m remediation check until all tickets moved to In Review.
jia: fine with twice-weekly, add a quick status update field in each ticket (blockers/next-steps/due).
sam: agreed. I can host the first check-in Wed 3/13 9am PT — will send calendar.
mira: ok — last ask: add a small prompt set and eval to catch regressions (RDW-3422 subtask). we want automated alerts if quality drops >2% on critical prompts.
jia: adding eval and alert subtask now.
lena: I'll make sure success/support are informed and add channel #postmortem-actions to broadcast milestones.
mira: thanks everyone — please update tickets before the first check-in. I'll close this thread once calendar invites and ticket checklists exist. :pray:
infra-oncall: noted, will prep capacity and monitoring dashboards for canary.
postmortem-bot: Reminder: follow-up sync scheduled 2026-03-13T16:00:00Z (automated).
mira: filing final note — owners: owen(RDW-3421), jia(RDW-3422), sam(RDW-3423). closing loop here; ping me if anything slips.
